decisions.reason: The client explicitly requires randomly allocated commissions to be registered so commission totals include every primary mint and exclude secondary-market sales.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should equal the number of mints, excluding secondary market sales, but those issued at random do not appear to be registering.

value_updates.random_commission_accounting: Commissions allocated at random for successful primary mints with no referral code or an invalid referral code must be registered in commission totals; secondary-market sales are excluded.
